'''Hyperwave comlinks''' were an enhanced form of [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] used during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']] with Luke's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] docked beneath and controlled by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], they set up a hyperwave comlink between R2 and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] in case anything went wrong with a docking maneuver they needed to preform and the ship's normal communications system didn't work.
